alex: Quick sanity check — I captured an Nsight timeline for a 8-GPU TP+PP run (seq_len=64) and I'm seeing repeated interleaved gaps right after forward all-reduce start. nvprof trace shows long idle on rank 2 during reduce. snippet from nsight: 
```
Time(ms)  Kernel/Comm
0.0       launch
1.4       allreduce_start(ring=3)
1.4-3.8   kern_attention_qk
3.9       allreduce_end
4.0       kv_cache_write
```
Can someone sanity-check if this looks like a kernel selection or batching heuristic issue?

maria: Do you have the per-op kernel choices? Could be a quantized kernel that falls back on one GPU. Also which NCCL version? We saw weird rendezvous timeout on 2.x.

alex: NCCL 2.12.9 across all nodes. Per-op kernel map attached in the capture: rank order shows rank 2 uses `attn_kv_flat_fallback` while others use `attn_kv_fast`. Also note microbatching was 4 microbatches per global step.

devon: If one rank uses fallback kernel with a divergent launch configuration that can force synchronization points and block the ring progress. Two quick checks: 1) try forcing `attn_kv_fast` via env override to see if latency hole disappears; 2) enable our custom timer around allreduce and kv write to get precise overlap numbers.

ben: I ran a small repro in CI (4 GPUs) with the env override; allreduce tail latency dropped ~28% and idle on rank 2 vanished. Repro gist: 
```
export RW_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=attn_kv_fast
python -m runtime.infer --model=my_mpt --seq_len=64 --microbatch=4
```
No perf regression seen in other kernels.

alex: Nice — so likely kernel selection heuristic misfire. Two follow-ups: (a) why did kernel picker choose fallback on rank 2 only? (b) batching heuristic might be edge-caseing for the microbatch size distribution (one GPU saw a slightly larger last microbatch).

maria: For (a) check memory allocation alignment and whether that rank hit a slow path (e.g., non-contiguous KV layout). For (b) we should add a metric: `microbatch_size_variance` and emit to tracing so Console can graph per-slot imbalance.

infra-bot: perf-test job #34821 queued: repro-run with RW_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=attn_kv_fast (4xA100) — will post results. :gear:

devon: Also adding a custom timer PR to measure effective overlap: `timer_allreduce_start`, `timer_allreduce_end`, `timer_kv_write_start`, `timer_kv_write_end`. If we compute overlap = max(0, allreduce_end - kv_write_start), we can quantify wasted time. I'll open the PR and add instrumentation gated by `RW_PERF_TIMERS=1`.

ben: One more datapoint — when I forced microbatching to 8 microbatches (smaller per-call sizes) the ring behaved and all ranks used fast kernel. So batching heuristic interacts with kernel selection. Might be threshold logic like `if tokens_per_call < X -> choose fallback` that we tuned for single-GPU but breaks multi-GPU.

alex: OK: next steps agreed: 1) devon adds timers and emits overlap metric; 2) infra runs perf-test with kernel override; 3) maria investigates kernel picker for non-contiguous KV layout; 4) ben tries adding a smoothing rule to batching heuristic to avoid one-off small tail microbatches. We'll sync tomorrow after test results. Thanks! :thumbsup:
